description: This file defines the ShippingEvents class, which contains methods for handling shipping-related calculations, such as obtaining shipping estimates, interacting with external shipping services, and retrieving shipping address information within the Apache OFBiz framework. The class is central to processing shipping fees, estimating shipment times, and integrating external shipment services.

classes.name: ShippingEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing shipping and shipment estimation methods for the OFBiz framework. It handles calculations for shipping costs, estimates shipment times, interacts with external shipping services, and retrieves shipping addresses.

methods.name: getShipEstimate
methods.description: Calculates shipping estimates for the current shopping cart in the context of an HTTP request, updating cart estimates and applying promotions.

methods.name: getShipGroupEstimate
methods.description: Provides a shipping estimate for a specific shipment group based on various parameters like shipment method, carrier, and address info.

methods.name: getShipEstimate
methods.description: Calculates shipping estimate based on an order helper object and a shipment group ID.

methods.name: getShipGroupEstimate
methods.description: Main method that performs detailed calculation of shipping estimates, potentially calling external services, considering allowances, minimum prices, and drop shipments.

methods.name: getGenericShipEstimate
methods.description: Invokes a generic shipment cost estimate service to determine shipping costs.

methods.name: getShipmentCustomMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the service name associated with a shipment custom method ID.

methods.name: getExternalShipEstimate
methods.description: Calls an external shipping estimation service, passing necessary parameters and handling responses.

methods.name: getShippingOriginContactMech
methods.description: Retrieves the primary shipping origin address for a supplier, falling back to general location if specific address is unavailable.

methods.name: getShippingOriginContactMechFromFacility
methods.description: Gets the shipping origin address associated with a specific facility.

methods.name: getGeoIdFromPostalContactMech
methods.description: Extracts geographical IDs from a postal address contact mech.

methods.name: getShipmentTimeEstimates
methods.description: Retrieves shipment time estimates based on shipping address or geographic identifiers.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimate
methods.description: Finds the shipping time estimate matching a shipment method and configured estimates, based on carrier and destination info.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimateInDay
methods.description: Converts and returns the estimated shipping time in days as a double, based on the stored estimate data.
